card.name: Words that lead into "day"
card.fires_on: Words or numbers right before an expected "day" or "/day", such as the mg in "3 mg/day" or the 1 in "21-day cycle". Also "the" before "day before", and "Un" before "mes" in Spanish.

modes.label: Dose per day
modes.description: The unit or number just before "/day" in a daily dose table or list.
